scope.body:
Add `countNonEmptyLines(text)` to `src/lines.mjs`. Reuse `splitLines` to count lines whose contents are not empty. Whitespace-only lines count. Empty input, blank lines, and trailing separators do not add to the count.

Add tests for empty input, mixed LF and CRLF, whitespace-only lines, trailing separators, and non-string input. Preserve the existing `splitLines` behavior and run the repository's existing checks.

Use this change to exercise protected delivery from a freshly installed Runner using the current pinned candidate versions. Verify the resulting Issue, Actions run, PR checks, merge, closure, and cleanup through the normal Nibfin workflow.
